landing.subtitle: Upload a photo of an ingredient list to check it against your allergens.

howItWorks.title: How it works
steps: A photo of the label is read with OCR.
Each ingredient is matched against INCI names and known synonyms.
Anything on your personal allergen list gets flagged.

why.title: Why I built it
why.body: A family member has allergies to cosmetic ingredients that are hard to spot on a label. This started as a tool for them.
